gloss: in scattered drops; one by one; haltingly

definitions.gloss: in scattered drops; one by one; here and there
definitions.explanation: Describes things falling or appearing singly at intervals — the first drops of rain, people arriving a few at a time, lights dotted across a dark landscape.
Describes speech that comes out slowly in short bursts with pauses between, typically because the speaker is reluctant, tired, or choosing words with care.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぽつりぽつり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
examples.english: The rain began to fall in scattered drops.

⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぽつりぽつり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。

notes:
A mimetic adverb, almost always used with ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧. It is a variant of ⟦ぽつぽつ→ぽつぽつ：06683_potsupotsu⟧ built on ぽつり, and carries a slower, more spaced-out feeling: each drop, person, or phrase is separated by a noticeable gap.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぽつりぽつり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: to fall in scattered drops
- ぽつりぽつり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧: to talk haltingly
- ぽつりぽつり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: to gather a few at a time

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぽつぽつ→ぽつぽつ：06683_potsupotsu⟧: bit by bit; in drops — the same range of meaning, but faster and more continuous
- ⟦ちらほら→ちらほら：30232_chirahora⟧: here and there — about scattered numbers only, never about speech
